data.goal: Which transcription factors have cell type enriched RNA expression, and in which single cell types? Give the number of such transcription factors per cell type as a bar chart of the fifteen cell types with the most. For the cell type with the most, list its transcription factors with their nCPM, the distribution of their RNA tissue specificity categories as a bar chart, and which of them have a validated prognostic association in any TCGA cohort. Provide the table.

columns: RNA single cell type specific nCPM_value

limitations: The 'RNA single cell type specific nCPM' column in proteinatlas.tsv records only the single top-enriched cell type per gene; a TF may be enriched in additional cell types at lower fold-change that are not captured here.

The validated prognostic association columns record only the p-value threshold met (favorable or unfavorable); the specific statistical test, hazard ratio, and cohort size are not available in this release.

The 92 TFs are those annotated under the protein class 'Transcription factors' in the Human Protein Atlas; TFs annotated under other protein classes (e.g. 'Transcription factor, nuclear') are excluded.
